payload.intro: Sandwiches, dearie! Fresh from my tray. Only, one of these never makes it on there.
payload.prompt: Which of these is never on my tray?
payload.explanation: She offers a baguette, a triangle or square sandwich, a chocolate bar, a kebab, a roll or a meat pie. Never a doughnut.

payload.intro: Manta ray on rye, dearie? Took me years before I could cook one without burning it.
payload.prompt: What Cooking level do you need to cook a manta ray?
payload.explanation: Raw manta ray needs 91 Cooking, and only a Cooking cape stops it burning altogether.

payload.intro: Those Fitzharmon boys each hand out gauntlets. One pair keeps my fish from burning to a crisp.
payload.prompt: Which gauntlets from the Fitzharmon brothers make you burn fewer lobsters, swordfish and sharks?
payload.explanation: After Family Crest, Caleb Fitzharmon turns your gauntlets into cooking gauntlets. They also help with monkfish, anglerfish and kyatt.

payload.intro: An anglerfish sandwich fills you up past the brim, dear. But by how much?
payload.prompt: How many hitpoints does an anglerfish heal at 99 Hitpoints?
payload.explanation: At 99 Hitpoints an anglerfish heals 22, and it may take you above your maximum, up to 121.

payload.intro: Four fish for your lunch, dearie, but one of them goes down differently from the rest.
payload.prompt: Which of these foods doesn't belong?
payload.explanation: A cooked karambwan can be eaten in the same tick right after other food. That trick is called combo eating.
